title: [SD-7] Slug uniqueness under concurrency
detail: CONFIRMED SD-7: reproduced in 1/8 attempts — a concurrent getOrCreateDefaultStore pair (two businesses computing the same base slug) hit an UNHANDLED PrismaClientKnownRequestError "Unique constraint failed on the fields: (`slug`)" thrown from store.ts's prisma.store.create() call (getOrCreateDefaultStore, store.ts:41). HTTP status stayed 200 (React already began streaming), but the RSC payload embeds "Switched to client rendering because the server rendering errored" and the losing business ends up with NO store row at all.
